author_instruction: So why have you stopped. We need to continue until we hit 100% on pangram consistently?
authority: The author explicitly requires continued iterative experiments and repeatability testing. Earlier instructions limiting detector observations to a single attempt do not terminate this authorized experimental work.
preserved_requirements: Code constructs conceptual and epistemic structure with rules and actual exemplars before expression.
Code realizes closed acts rhetorically and linguistically, then checks all four layers.
Original ledgers, source text, previous runs, findings and detector thresholds remain unchanged.
A new candidate must preserve source meaning and uncertainty; no manually authored prose or plan is backfilled into run records.
A detector result does not grant authorial approval or waive a writing finding.
experimental_protocol: Register each variant and immutable configuration before generation.
Observe previously unscanned exact draft versions to measure the effects of individual repairs; reuse existing results for already-scanned hashes.
Continue a diagnosed expression repair only under a new explicitly bound continuation, preserving the parent execution and its exhausted budget.
Run independent fresh generations to assess a fixed candidate procedure; retain every unsuccessful attempt.

Declare a confirmation batch of five fresh runs using one frozen configuration. A batch passes only if all five final exact paragraphs pass every writing check and the unchanged Pangram all-human-v1 policy.
A failed confirmation batch remains failed. Changing the procedure requires a newly declared batch; a selected streak is not a reliability estimate.
Validate across additional source paragraphs before extending a same-source result into a general claim about the writing procedure.
measurement_scope: The first confirmation target is operational repeatability for the present paragraph task. It is not a guarantee of all future writing, a population success-rate estimate, or author validation.
initial_evidence: RECOVERY_001 and RECOVERY_002 reached fraction_human 1.0 with linguistic findings remaining; RECOVERY_003 through RECOVERY_005 passed writing review but failed the detector policy. The prior five trials did not complete both gates on one paragraph.
loop_ownership: Existing Execution, Faculty, Expression, Checking, Editing, ParagraphLoop and PangramCheck owners remain authoritative. Experiment commands orchestrate them; they do not replace the lifecycle.
